auction_history.sql:
CREATE TABLE auction_history (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        lot_id INTEGER,
        event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor_user_id INTEGER,
        seller_user_id INTEGER,
        buyer_user_id INTEGER,
        item_name TEXT,
        category TEXT,
        quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        price TEXT,
        status_before TEXT,
        status_after TEXT,
        details_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

auction_lots.sql:
CREATE TABLE auction_lots (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

        seller_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        buyer_user_id INTEGER,

        item_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        item_source TEXT DEFAULT '',
        item_ref_id INTEGER,
        item_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,

        item_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        item_name_norm TEXT NOT NULL,
        category TEXT NOT NULL,
        rarity TEXT DEFAULT '',
        level INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        enhancement_level INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        durability_current INTEGER,
        durability_max INTEGER,
        quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 1,

        price TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',

        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        sold_at TEXT,
        claimed_at TEXT,
        delete_after TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

equipment_slots.sql:

        user_id INTEGER,
        slot_key TEXT,
        inventory_id INTEGER,
        PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot_key)
    )

    , refine_level INTEGER DEFAULT 0)

inventory_runes.sql:
CREATE TABLE inventory_runes (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            inventory_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            slot_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(slot_index >= 0),
            rune_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            rune_stat TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(rune_stat IN ('STR','STA','DEX','INT','WIS')),
            rune_level INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rune_level BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
            inserted_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            UNIQUE(inventory_id, slot_index),
            FOREIGN KEY(inventory_id) REFERENCES inventory(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY(rune_item_id) REFERENCES items(id)
        )
